metadata.description: Internal Claude Code skills for the Espresso Clinical team

plugins.name: sdlc
plugins.description: SDLC feature workflow agent — guides from Monday ticket through PR submission

plugins.name: protocol-kri-extractor
plugins.description: Extracts Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) from clinical trial protocol PDFs for CRA monitoring

plugins.name: kri-regression-tester
plugins.description: Regression testing for KRI golden sets — detects when extractor skill updates break approved outputs

plugins.name: accompanying-doc-kri-extractor
plugins.description: Extracts KRIs from clinical-trial accompanying documents (CMP, CSMP, IMP, PDHP, PV Plan, SAP, PD Classification Guide), deduplicated against the protocol's golden set

plugins.name: soa-kri-extractor
plugins.description: Extracts SOA (Schedule of Activities) KRIs from clinical trial protocol PDFs — covers both the structured SoA table and narrative cross-visit / methodology / long-term-tracking rules

plugins.name: amendment-sync
plugins.description: Syncs an existing Golden Set to a new version of a clinical-trial document (protocol or accompanying doc) by diffing old vs new, locating affected KRIs, and running an interactive change-by-change review — without re-running the full extractor

plugins.name: golden-set-binary-rule-distiller
plugins.description: Distills a clinical-trial Golden Set into only the binary, deviation-producing rules with machine-readable rewritten Rule for LLM column, verified against the source protocol PDF

plugins.name: rule-deviation-mapper-resolve
plugins.description: Refines an existing clinical-trial Golden Set so its rules catch the real, protocol-grounded deviations they should — driven by a deviation-to-rule mapping (Extend-partial + No-match tabs). Works family-by-family editing only the Rule for LLM cell; authors new protocol-grounded rules for No-match. Protocol is the only source of truth; mandatory traceability + approval ritual before every edit.
